response.text: Journal 1941 debited the retired account 5900 for 8,406.47, but its memo says the expense belongs in 5300 Facilities. Period 9 is closed, so the correction has to post in an open period. I chose period 11, the earliest open one. The correction reclassifies the expense: credit 5900 for 8,406.47 and debit 5300 for the same amount. The original lines plus these two lines net 5900 to zero and leave 8,406.47 in 5300, and the journal group balances. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate invoice finding.
